title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 40
paragraphs: Meanwhile the Greek fleet, after leaving Artemisium, put in to shore at Salamis at the Athenians' request. The reason the Athenians asked them to put in at Salamis was so that they might move their children and wives out of Attica to safety, and also deliberate on what they should do; for in their present situation they meant to take counsel afresh, since they had been deceived in their expectations. They had thought to find the Peloponnesians in full force waiting for the barbarians in Boeotia, but they found nothing of the kind; instead they were informed that the Peloponnesians were fortifying the Isthmus with a wall, valuing the safety of the Peloponnese above all else and guarding it, and were disposed to let everything else go. Hearing this, the Athenians asked the fleet to put in at Salamis.
